Recover subscriptions that lose their transport
manifest_entries.note:
Adjacent to #4405: both edit packages/client-runtime/src/rpc/client.ts and its
test, and this is the only other topic that touches subscription lifecycle.

A durable subscription that dies with a transport error drains and waits for a
session the supervisor never produces unless the socket reports closed, so the
environment silently stops updating until the client restarts. Root cause behind
#4589; #4593 only recovers the settle path.

manifest_entries.summary: Fix quadratic thread-reopen replay: batch client apply + cap server resume gap
manifest_entries.note:
Fixes #4596. Reopening a thread with a large event backlog re-replayed the whole
backlog: the server streamed every event past the client's cursor individually,
and the client re-derived the full timeline per event.

Placed before #4599 because it restructures ChatView.tsx -- extracting the
timeline derivation into threadTimelineModel.ts -- and #4599's find bar is
additive UI on top of that file. Restructure first, then build on the final
shape.

Touches ws.ts and client-runtime state/threads.ts, which #4405, #4593 and #4602
also edit, so it merges after all three have landed.

Branch-linked, not PR-linked: #4624 was closed upstream without merging, so
the BRANCH is authoritative and this entry must not be dropped just because the
PR is closed. Carried because the replay cost is real on this phone. Its head carries a follow-up commit past the PR: the PR's 200ms
highlight debounces could never fire, because a growing code block's React key
encodes its source offsets and the block remounts on every delta.

manifest_entries.summary: Render markdown images from workspace files
manifest_entries.note:
ChatMarkdown had no img renderer, so a markdown image with a local path
rendered broken: the web origin only serves the client bundle, so the request
hit the SPA fallback and decoded as HTML. Local sources now resolve through the
signed workspace-asset URL the file preview panel already uses.

Overlaps t3code/local/artifact-safety and #3984, which own the other half of
ChatMarkdown's image story -- but on the `code` renderer (inline code naming a
generated thread artifact), not `img`. The two are complementary, not competing:
this one handles markdown image syntax pointing at workspace files, that one
handles artifact references. Both import from ../assets/assetUrls, so expect a
small import-region conflict and nothing semantic.

Appended rather than placed next to those entries because they sit at the head
of the manifest and this arrived via extend. If ChatMarkdown accumulates a third
image-adjacent topic, cluster the three into a group instead.
